image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle view of a staircase featuring a modern handrail. Two human arms are visible in the foreground, one on the left wearing a blue shirt sleeve and holding the rail, and one on the right also in blue, resting near the rail. The handrail is dark, sleek, and appears metallic or composite, running diagonally upwards from left to right. Below the rail, light-colored wooden steps are visible. In the background, out-of-focus greenery (a palm-like plant) and a building facade with windows can be seen. The lighting is bright and natural.
